ResPrint_literal_derivation.method: AST literal replacements/text hashes only; no patch function import/execution or compilation.

findings.finding: rnode writes stored rn_loc x/y; final type field is literally0. Patches add intrinsic-C retirement and extra C digits without changing x/y/type.
resist writes endpoint names/value, omitting rr_tt, width, via identity and path polygon.

findings.fact: resResistor stores rr_value, rr_node[2], rr_status, rr_tt, rr_cl, rr_width and rr_area/rr_i union, but no footprint polygon/rectangle. Struct/ABI remains unchanged.

The two conductor constructors derive R from actual sheet resistance, breakpoint interval and tile height/width. Sidecar observes tile bbox, split direction/types, both breakpoint coordinates/contact rectangles, and raw initialized resistor fields. The tile is a fractured extraction tile, not an assertion about one GDS polygon.

Contact constructor uses rr_cl=squares_y and rr_width=squares_x. Sidecar records actual cp_rect/center/dimensions/layer-pair tiles and all current integer constructor inputs. Contact region is not individual via-cut polygons.
FastHenry comment says x/y opposite to the constructor. This patch preserves raw values and constructor squares_x/squares_y explicitly and does not borrow the misleading comment.
Series/parallel/triangle rewrites change rr_value/endpoints without recomputing complete material/width/centerline provenance. Final stored type/width cannot establish unique physical footprint.
Simplification also mutates/reuses/eliminates resistor objects. The patch records full before_simplify/after_simplify snapshots without altering or disabling simplification.

Original resist writer omits material/width geometry. Instrumentation follows the unchanged actual fprintf; orphan zero-resistor output is observed separately with no invented native resistor address/material.
Original rnode type remains literal zero. This patch does not reinterpret or rewrite it.
Each real extraction has a diagnostic epoch and cleanup-end marker. No native object field is assigned by the new C helper.

DBNumTypes, DBTypeLongNameTbl, exts_sheetResist, exts_viaResist, exts_resistScale and CIFGetOutputScale are verified declarations. Runtime material names and coefficients are observed directly, not guessed from endpoint coordinates.

patch.original_numeric_writers: All existing native source bytes and numerical/output statements remain, in original order. Actual stdout/ext/res.ext/SPICE/capacitance identity has NOT been executed or established.
patch.source_tree_boundary: CLI authenticates the five exact touched source files; twenty pinned primary-source hashes are review evidence. The future full-build controller must separately bind the entire fd12c39c upstream source and all inherited qualified patches/configuration. Five-file verification alone is not a full-build admission.

sidecar.file_open: fopen(path,"wx"), Linux/glibc exclusive creation; one new process-owned file; no replacement.
sidecar.naming: Exact original string bytes hex-encoded; raw pointers scoped only to this ordered process/epoch. Match a final pointer only to the latest preceding creation at that address in that epoch; never across runs, never infer physical ownership from pointer equality.
sidecar.field_semantics: All milliohm floats preserved as %a hex text; final ext_value_token repeats original float division and %g formatting. Integer scale/type/width/centerline/contact parameters retained. Runtime output unit is observed with CIFGetOutputScale(1000); previous 5 nm inference is not silently forced on another run.
sidecar.failure: Write/flush/open/close/atexit/nested-epoch failures emit NSSOC_RESISTOR_TRACE_ERROR and mark diagnostic state failed. The original numerical extractor is not short-circuited. Consumer must reject any such error, absent/truncated footer, open epoch or malformed/nonfinite observations; success of Magic alone never qualifies the sidecar.
sidecar.ownership: Creation geometry is exact observed constructor input. Reduction provenance is not a complete merge DAG: no final equivalent resistor footprint/material ownership is asserted even when final pointer/value/coordinates resemble a birth record. Sidecar retains all birth events and snapshots rather than silently collapsing duplicates.

hosted_source_controls.no_fake_native_proof: No C compile, mock C runtime, full Magic build, extraction, or actual trace validation is claimed. Tests are authored and have not been executed locally or in GitHub.
